name: PRI Approximation Error Measurement
definition: The error function \varepsilon_P(t) is the maximal residual error on tetrahedron t, computed over all four vertices.
summary: PRI Approximation Error Measurement quantifies the fidelity of a Pixel Ray Image relative to its source unstructured grid by evaluating sampling error at vertices, distinguishing itself by focusing on data structure reconstruction rather than visual output.
